def execute_ryze_realm_warp_league(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Creates a magic portal that teleports Ryze and nearby allies to another location.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    entry, exit = validate_portal_anchors(actor, points)
    pair = portal_registry.create_bidirectional_or_oneway(entry, exit)
    on_entity_cross(pair.entry, lambda e: portal_transform(e, pair.exit))
    transform_velocity_and_orientation_consistently(e)
    on_close: unregister_both_portal_surfaces(pair)
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
